 James O’Keefe, Cam Higby charged with felony unlawful voting, identity theft in Minnesota
 Hennepin County prosecutors say the two men gave election judges the names of real registered voters at precincts during the Aug. 11 primary, without those voters’ knowledge, while filming a video about the state’s vouching rule. Neither cast a ballot.
